how_scores_work: Each version gets up to 100 points: evidence that people have this problem (30 points), fit with your skills, budget and time (25 points), places to reach these customers (20 points), can be built as a first version (15 points), room next to existing options (10 points). These weights are design choices, not facts (config/scoring.toml).

points.Evidence that people have this problem: 18 of 30: Found 4 real examples of people describing this problem or looking for help with it, on alemiguel.com, domestika.org, ramp.com and winvesta.in. Full marks need 5. Of these, 2 are people describing it first-hand or asking for help; 2 are articles or other pages (these count a little less); 2 of 4 are about your market (the others count less). For example: “Freelance designers in Barcelona say they don’t know how to budget and feel unsure about pricing their work” / “A Spanish freelance designer notes that a client told her she was too cheap, showing uncertainty about setting rates”.
points.Fit with your skills, budget and time: 25 of 25: You already have what it takes for writing clear client emails; it needs about 8 hours (you have about 24 a month) and about $15 (your budget is $150).
points.Places to reach these customers: 20 of 20: These customers can be found on fiverr.com and upwork.com.
points.Can be built as a first version: 15 of 15: It's a pack of ready-to-use templates, which the team can build, and it fits in about a month of your time.
points.Room next to existing options: 0 of 10: Found 6 existing options but no complaints about them. Complaints show where you could do better.
